items.statement: Inventory reduced by Rs. 100 crore at standalone India level improving working capital
items.quote: during this particular quarter, our inventory has come down at standalone India level almost by Rs. 100 crores. So, that has helped in terms of at the cash flow level by improving working capital.

items.statement: Net working capital cycle improved from 196 days to 181 days year-on-year
items.quote: last year, our net working capital cycle was 196 days and it has come down to 181 days. So, ther e is an improvement of 15 days which is quite

items.statement: Expect Rs. 125 crore reduction in government project receivables in Q4 FY26
items.quote: in current quarter, fourth quarter, I think w e are expecting a lot reduction to the tune of about Rs. 125 crores or so from government projects alone on net

items.statement: Expect Rs. 350-400 crore reduction in government project receivables in FY27
items.quote: next fiscal year, I think the reduction should be close to Rs. 350 crores to Rs. 400 crores due to the government projects.

items.statement: Company has positive operating cash flow post working capital changes for last 8 quarters
items.quote: Companies having positive cash flow from the operations post working capital changes, as has been over last I th ink 8 quarters or so, and that is allowing us to make necessary investment where required as well as the service debt

items.statement: QIP of Rs. 500 crore approved but not yet acted upon; may wait longer to implement
items.quote: we have not acted upon that resolution as of now because I think where we are in overall cycle of business, business is do ing well, right? Even without that additional infusion, we could raise, we could do this quarter 17% growth in revenue, and current quarter we are planning 20

items.statement: Tomato processing JV signed as 51%-49% with Japanese company; revenue from January 2027
items.quote: The tomato processing JV, we have recently signed. It would be a 51%-49% JV with a Japanese company. And we are in process of setting up what needs to be done. But the actual revenue will start coming only from next January, January '27.

items.statement: Beverage bottling unit is contract manufacturing with partner inside Jain Farm Fresh, no separate JV
items.quote: The bottling beverage unit which we have is a part of the main company, Jain Farm Fresh, which is there. So, it is inside the main company. There is no particular JV there. It is more of a collaborative approach with a contract manufacturing with our partner.
